findings.title: save_path= with user-supplied ax= saves whatever figure is pyplot-current, not the plotted figure
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, hypertools as hyp
plt.switch_backend('Agg')
data = np.random.randn(60, 4).cumsum(axis=0)
userfig = plt.figure(figsize=(4, 4))
userax = userfig.add_subplot(111, projection='3d')
decoy = plt.figure(figsize=(2, 2)); plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1])  # decoy is now current
fig = hyp.plot(data, ax=userax, save_path='out.png', show=False)
from PIL import Image; print(Image.open('out.png').size)  # -> (200, 200): the decoy
findings.expected: out.png contains the hypertools plot drawn on userax (400x400 px)
findings.actual: saved pixels=(200, 200) -- PNG shows the decoy diagonal-line figure; returned fig is user fig: True

findings.title: Saving an animation as .apng silently destroys a pre-existing sibling .png file
findings.repro:
import os, numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import hypertools as hyp
open('movie.png', 'w').write('PRECIOUS USER DATA')
data = np.random.randn(30, 4).cumsum(axis=0)
hyp.plot(data, animate=True, save_path='movie.apng', duration=2, frame_rate=10, show=False)
print(os.path.exists('movie.png'))  # -> False: user file destroyed
findings.expected: movie.apng written; unrelated pre-existing movie.png untouched
findings.actual: apng ok=True; sibling movie.png survived=False, content_intact=False, now=b''

findings.title: pathlib.Path save_path crashes animated matplotlib saves and ALL plotly saves (works for static matplotlib)
findings.repro:
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import hypertools as hyp
data = np.random.randn(30, 4).cumsum(axis=0)
hyp.plot(data, animate=True, save_path=Path('anim.gif'), duration=1, frame_rate=5, show=False)
findings.expected: anim.gif written (like static save_path=Path('x.png'), which works)
findings.actual: AttributeError: 'PosixPath' object has no attribute 'lower' (also raised for backend='plotly' with Path('x.html'))

findings.title: save_path misuse produces cryptic or silent failures (no up-front validation)
findings.repro:
import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import hypertools as hyp
data = np.random.randn(20, 3)
hyp.plot(data, save_path=123, show=False)          # AttributeError: 'int' object has no attribute 'write'
hyp.plot(data, save_path='', show=False)           # silently writes hidden file '.png'
hyp.plot(data, save_path='~/f.png', show=False)    # FileNotFoundError: '~/f.png'
hyp.plot(data, animate=True, save_path='x.html', duration=1, frame_rate=5, show=False)  # CalledProcessError (ffmpeg dump)
findings.expected: each case raises ValueError/TypeError naming save_path, the problem, and the fix (e.g. list supported animation extensions: gif, png, apng, svg, mp4, mov, avi)
findings.actual: AttributeError: 'int' object has no attribute 'write' | no error + hidden '.png' file created | FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '~/hypertools_f09_tilde_test.png' | CalledProcessError: Command '['ffmpeg', '-f', 'rawvideo', ... '-y', '.../anim.html']' + MovieWriter stderr: Unable to choose an output format

findings.title: show=True semantics differ by backend in plain scripts: plotly displays, matplotlib silently does nothing (and accumulates figures)
findings.repro:
MPLBACKEND=Agg python -c "
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, hypertools as hyp
data = np.random.randn(50, 4).cumsum(axis=0)
for _ in range(25): hyp.plot(data, show=True)
print(len(plt.get_fignums()))"  # 25 + RuntimeWarning; nothing was ever displayed
findings.expected: consistent show= semantics across backends (either both display in scripts, or matplotlib documents that display only happens in notebooks)
findings.actual: fignums 0->25; RSS 238.2->314.6MB; mpl warning: 'More than 20 figures have been opened. Figures created through the pyplot interface (`matplotlib.pyplot.figure`) are ret...'; no window/display ever produced by the matplotlib path
